name: Day dial
description: A clock hand sweeps once round the speaker's head and wipes the room away to warm paper. A clock face draws on behind the head as the hand passes, with serif numbers and a word in every hour. Then the hand sweeps back and the room returns.
when: When you talk about time: a day, a routine, 'every hour', 'in one day'.
needs: the place of the speaker's head
the word for every hour and the word on the hand
the cut time where it starts
a cutout of the speaker (made in the steps)
